settings.label: Settings
settings.title: Tailor your experience
settings.description: Switch themes instantly and keep sound preferences locked in. Minimal interfaces, lightning-fast feedback.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose a light or dark palette crafted around red, black, and white.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch between English and Spanish translations for every screen.

sound.title: Sound
sound.label: Thunder sound
sound.description: Play a thunder strike whenever you earn new points.
sound.helper: This sound effect is off by default and saved to your preferences.

courses.label: Education Hub
courses.title: Courses engineered for clarity and more effective learning
courses.description: Our courses incorporate neurological principles to help you learn more effectively. Customize lessons based on your 'learning style,' and prioritize the topics that interest you most so you stay engaged from the very start.

newsletter.label: Newsletter
newsletter.title: Stay ahead without the noise
newsletter.description: No spam, just essential updates, new lessons, and product drops.

hud.loginPrompt: Create an account so your points and lesson progress are saved.

courseNavigation.title: Explore the course map
courseNavigation.description: Use the course navigation on the right to jump between lessons. On mobile tap Course Content to open it.

lessonFlow.title: Work through each lesson
lessonFlow.description: Every topic starts with a video overview followed by three lessons and quizzes to lock in what you learn.

pointsAndStreaks.title: Earn points & streaks
pointsAndStreaks.description: Completing lessons and quizzes adds to your points and daily streak shown in this HUD.

saveProgress.title: Save your progress
saveProgress.description: Log in so your points and streak days stay with you on any device.

customize.title: Customize what's next
customize.description: Use the customize button to tailor upcoming lessons. Filters are coming soon!

errors.invalid: Incorrect user or password, try again

register.storeRecovery: Store encrypted private key for recovery
register.warning: If you lose your password and recovery key, you lose access to your Nostr identity.

forgotPassword.title: Reset Password
forgotPassword.success: Check your email for a reset link.
